what_it_is.prose: Wipro Infrastructure Engineering (WIN) is the industrial engineering arm of Wipro Enterprises, with expertise spanning hydraulics, aerospace, water treatment and additive manufacturing. WIN's aerospace business was set up in 2013 as a solutions provider for actuators (cylinder and piston) and aerostructures. Wipro Aerospace operates a separate website (wiproaerospace.com) and is positioned as a Tier-1 aerostructures and actuation supplier to global aerospace OEMs. On 18 June 2025, Wipro Infrastructure Engineering announced (at the Paris Air Show) exclusive negotiations to acquire a majority stake in France's Lauak Group — a Tier-1 aircraft parts and aerostructures provider with strong European OEM relationships; the transaction closed in December 2025. This acquisition reinforces Wipro's position as a trusted industrial partner in France and strengthens its European aerospace footprint. WIN is the largest independent hydraulic cylinder manufacturer in the world, delivering around 2 million cylinders to OEMs globally.
